descriptionChirho: A proper noun designating Meshech, a people or region in Asia Minor frequently paired with Tubal in prophetic and genealogical contexts (Genesis 10:2; 1 Chronicles 1:5; Psalm 120:5; Ezekiel 27:13, 32:26, 38:2-3, 39:1). Multilingual glosses consistently transliterate: English 'Meshech/Meshekh,' Spanish 'Mesec,' Hindi 'Meshek' (मेशेक), Arabic 'Mashak' (مَاشَكَ/ماشِك), Korean 'Mesep/Mesek' (메셉/메섹), Swahili 'Mesheki.' The two clusters differ only by conjunction waw and prepositional context, not by referent or semantic content.
